observations.observed: Complete legible face of the Italian EX Dragon Frontiers Snorlax: name bar 'Snorlax' with 'δ SPECIE DELTA', 80 PV, Poké-BODY 'Assonnato', Poké-POWER 'Ciondolare', Italian weakness/resistance/retreat labels 'debolezza', 'resistenza', 'costo di ritirata', Illus. Masakazu Fukuda, ©2007 Pokémon/Nintendo, 10/101 with the star rarity symbol. The artwork field carries no EX Dragon Frontiers set-logo stamp, so this is the regular holo, not the stamped reverse holo.

physicalObservation.basis: The official EX Dragon Frontiers checklist gives cards 1-12 exactly two foil versions: the regular holo and the reverse holo, which carries the EX Dragon Frontiers set-logo stamp in the artwork field. The complete, legible face of 10/101 shows no such stamp, so the photographed copy is the regular holo.
